title: RunnerSnapshot
description: Stable read-surface wire shape mesh emits to console-ui for the scheduler/runner panel. DELIBERATELY NARROW: run-state + counts + last-tick only. DISTINCT from mesh's internal SchedulerStatus, which ALSO exposes scheduler internals (priority_profiles, lane_environment_pools, homeostasis). Ledger fix: those internals are kept OUT so a read panel never couples to scheduler policy. run_state + per-runner status stay OPEN strings. additionalProperties:false makes a smuggled internal a structural validation failure. The TypeScript interface in src/read-surface-runner.ts is the paired source of truth.

run_state.description: Authority-resolved overall scheduler run-state. OPEN string.

tick_running.description: Whether a scheduler tick is in flight.

runners.description: Per-runner run-states (narrow projection). No priority/lane/homeostasis internals.
